description: Parameterized runtime scheduler regression: for each provider and each pending_revocation/failed_permanent state, block that provider and run every target of the other; include a tombstoned empty credential map for the blocked provider.

Runtime scheduler behavior matrix: both blocked runs neither; finalized/no-record runs both providers and all organisations; no targets is a no-op; retain CE and auto-sync-disabled behavior through existing or extended behavioral coverage.

Parameterized action regressions for Sync Now, invoice sync enqueue, and drift re-export in both provider directions: an unrelated disconnect permits the selected operation with its original tenant/provider/organisation; a same-provider disconnect prevents cycles and queue writes.

Action selection and authorization behavior: a blocked explicit provider with tombstoned credentials reports its disconnect, a missing explicit organisation never falls back, and insufficient permission never invokes a cycle or enqueues an operation.

DB-backed happy path against migrated schema: persist an unrelated provider's failed_permanent disconnect and a historical healthy-provider failure, exercise real guard/target/cycle repositories with the external adapter stubbed, and verify a new successful healthy-provider cycle is returned by health reads while old history and the unrelated disconnect remain unchanged.

DB-backed guard and isolation path: persist a same-provider non-finalized disconnect, exercise selected-provider dispatch, and verify no cycle/export operation is written for that provider; an equivalent record in another tenant does not block eligible work.

Running-app smoke test with disposable local data: create the asymmetric disconnect state, confirm healthy-provider Sync Now succeeds through the existing panel and replaces the old most-recent error, and confirm the other provider still displays its disconnect/recovery state; disclose provider adapter simulation.
